recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32753 unless a future work-group decision reopens SubscriptionTopic trigger modeling or CanonicalResource inheritance.
issue_request: FHIR-32753 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked for SubscriptionTopic to declare CanonicalResource as its parent, change SubscriptionTopic.publisher from Reference to string, make resourceTrigger.description markdown, and replace resourceTrigger.canFilterBy.documentation with a description element of type markdown.
initial_application: No current git commit was found with an explicit FHIR-32753 subject for the SubscriptionTopic source. The requested shape appears to have been applied implicitly across SubscriptionTopic updates: R4B-era changes introduced publisher:string mapping and canFilterBy.description markdown, and da73c85400492e9a0f667c5210892319ea53ab67 later changed the SubscriptionTopic template/baseDefinition from MetadataResource to CanonicalResource while re-adding inherited metadata elements.
additional_context: SubscriptionTopic is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-46492 collapsed resourceTrigger and eventTrigger into trigger and moved canFilterBy under trigger, while fhir.ini keeps aliases from the older paths to the current paths. Zulip search found the subscription block-vote thread listing FHIR-32753, and Confluence refs search found no direct references or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current StructureDefinition declares the CanonicalResource template/baseDefinition, defines SubscriptionTopic.publisher as string, and has markdown types for SubscriptionTopic.trigger.description and SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy.description. Searches found no stale authoritative resourceTrigger.canFilterBy.documentation element requiring a source edit.

related_jiras.note: Collapsed resourceTrigger/eventTrigger into trigger and moved canFilterBy beneath trigger, explaining why current paths differ from the FHIR-32753 resolution wording.
